zh_text: A1. 請問您主要透過何種管道得知本次電子煙衛教活動？（請選一項）
en_text: A1. What was the main way you learned about this e-cigarette education activity? (Choose one)

zh_text: A3. 您的實際年齡？（實歲）
en_text: A3. How old are you? (completed years)

zh_text: A5. 您是否曾經使用電子煙？
en_text: A5. Have you ever used e-cigarettes? (optional)

zh_text: B1. 下列何者正確描述電子煙與加熱菸的差異？
en_text: B1. Which statement correctly describes the difference between e-cigarettes and heated tobacco products?

zh_text: K1. 電子煙只是水蒸氣，對身體沒有危害？
en_text: K1. E-cigarettes produce only water vapor and are harmless to health.
explain_zh: 電子煙產生的不是單純的水蒸氣，而是含有尼古丁、超細懸浮微粒、重金屬及其他化學物質的氣溶膠，會危害使用者及身旁的人。
explain_en: E-cigarettes do not produce just water vapor. Their aerosol can contain nicotine, ultrafine particles, heavy metals and other chemicals that can harm users and people nearby.

zh_text:
D. 健康信念
請選最符合您看法的選項：1 非常不同意／2 不同意／3 普通／4 同意／5 非常同意。
en_text:
D. Health Beliefs
Select the response closest to your view: 1 Strongly disagree / 2 Disagree / 3 Neither agree nor disagree / 4 Agree / 5 Strongly agree.

zh_text: H1. 我覺得自己可能受到電子煙或電子煙二手煙的危害。
en_text: H1. I think I could be harmed by e-cigarettes or secondhand e-cigarette aerosol.
hint_zh: ※ 電子煙二手煙：指旁人使用電子煙時產生的二手氣溶膠。
hint_en: Note: secondhand e-cigarette aerosol is the aerosol released when people nearby use e-cigarettes.

zh_text: H2. 我認為使用電子煙可能對健康造成嚴重傷害。
en_text: H2. I believe using e-cigarettes can cause serious harm to health.

zh_text: H3. 我認為遠離電子煙有助於保護自己與家人的健康。
en_text: H3. I believe staying away from e-cigarettes helps protect my health and my family's health.

zh_text: H4. 當別人邀請我使用電子煙時，我可能因為不好意思而難以拒絕。
en_text: H4. If someone offers me an e-cigarette, I may find it hard to say no because I feel uncomfortable refusing.

zh_text: H5. 即使朋友邀請我使用電子煙，我也有信心拒絕。
en_text: H5. Even if a friend offers me an e-cigarette, I am confident I can say no.

zh_text: S1. 今天的衛教影片及活動說明，是否有助於您了解電子煙危害及拒絕電子煙的方法？
en_text: S1. Did today's video and educational information help you understand vaping risks and ways to refuse e-cigarettes?

zh_text: 對本次活動有任何建議或想法嗎？（選填）
en_text: Any suggestions or comments about today's activity? (optional)
